bootstrap.multiplicity: Pointwise intervals for each metric/contrast; no familywise or multiple-comparison adjustment.

donor_design: 44 unique recipient physical groups paired one-to-one to 44 unique donor groups, with disjoint pools and no prior generation-development indices.
input_file_provenance_scope: Submission-time NPZ hashes are retained from validation_plan and their case/group mapping is checked. This summary does not rehash original NPZ files; matching actual batch tensor hashes establishes between-run input equality, not byte identity with submission-time NPZ files.
missing_and_invalid_data: Missing/failed seed pairs are explicitly excluded; invalid replay flags are retained in primary error statistics and counted, not silently filtered.

failure_evidence.root_cause: Undetermined; no retry_srun or experiment output despite zero wrapper exit.

scope: Confirmation on validation cases excluded from the prior generation-development diagnostics. These cases may have contributed to epochwise validation loss. This is not the untouched final test set; no automatic acceptance threshold is applied.
statistical_unit: 44 recipient cases; average sampling seeds 47/48 within case first, keep training seeds 31/32/33 separate

validation_plan.scope: Cases unused in prior generated-field development comparisons; validation losses may have included them previously. Not untouched test data.
validation_plan.selection_method: Python random.Random(seed).shuffle of manifest validation indices 12..100; first44 recipients, next44 donors, last1 unused

verification_scope: Actual batched tensor hashes and shape/dtype metadata pair observations, probes and masks across runs. Initial noise hashes and stochastic-update seeds pair draws within architecture. The immutable evaluator source records shared streams across conditions; full stochastic noise traces are not stored.
